user.description: Choose the printer. Make sure it is on and not connected to the phone app.

abort.already_configured: This printer is already set up.
abort.no_devices_found: No LX-D02 printer found. Turn it on (it switches itself off when idle), close the phone app, and make sure Home Assistant's Bluetooth (or a Bluetooth proxy) is in range.

print.name: Print receipt
print.description: Prints a receipt with any combination of icon, title, text, QR code and picture, stacked in that order. Leave a field empty to leave it off.

device_id.name: Printer
device_id.description: Which printer; optional when only one is set up.

text.name: Text
text.description: Body text in Markdown: # headings, **bold**, *italic*, ~~strike~~, `code`, - lists, - [ ] checklists, > quotes, tables, --- rules and ![picture](path). Line breaks are kept.

qr.name: QR code
qr.description: Any text to encode as a QR code: a URL, Wi-Fi details, etc.

icon.name: Icon
icon.description: MDI icon printed at the top, for example mdi:coffee.

image.name: Picture
image.description: Path of an image file on the Home Assistant host, scaled to the paper width. Its folder must be in allowlist_external_dirs.

size.name: Text size
size.description: Size of the title and text.

align.name: Text alignment
align.description: Alignment of the body text's paragraphs.

markdown.name: Markdown
markdown.description: Format the text as Markdown. Turn off to print it exactly as written.

energy.name: Darkness
energy.description: 1 (light) to 6 (dark); overrides the printer's Print darkness setting.

feed.name: Feed
feed.description: Extra blank paper after the receipt in mm, on top of the 10 mm the printer always feeds; overrides the Feed after printing setting.

device_id.name: Printer
device_id.description: Which printer; optional when only one is set up.

length.name: Length
length.description: How much paper comes out, in mm. At least 10 mm: the printer feeds that much by itself after every job.
